actions.description: Read the current sourced brand profile for this project.
List canonical capability readiness and connection guidance for this project.
Read the active live marketing plan, sections, and executable items.
Read at most 20 recent workflow statuses from the last 24 hours.
List the active tracked workflows configured for this project.
Read one active project workflow's complete authoring and schedule state by UUID.
List active workflow templates and whether this project already forked them.
Create or reuse a project workflow from one template slug and optional configured inputs. The gateway owns input-aware deduplication.
Create one reusable project workflow from bounded typed steps. Use a stable idempotency key and list existing workflows first to avoid duplicate intent.
Update selected fields on one active project workflow. Inputs and steps replace their complete arrays when supplied.
Request a recurring schedule for one workflow. This only mints one human-approval link; the schedule is installed after the user approves the exact cadence.
Remove the recurring schedule from one active project workflow.
Start one active project workflow as a durable tracked run for the verified current chat turn, then return immediately.
Update one active marketing-plan item using the verified current chat or plan-task workflow context.
Read at most 20 recent content-minimized Firehose matches.
Record one deduplicated internal heartbeat blocker or reconnect nudge.
Enqueue a live-plan recompile, then poll magister_get_compile_run until terminal.
Poll one live-plan compile run and return normalized terminal status.
Read persisted audit health and channel evidence for an audit plan.
List the complete active Magister skill index without loading skill bodies.
Load one active Magister SKILL.md body by exact catalog name.
List recent answer-engine optimization audits for this project.
Start an AEO audit and poll magister_get_aeo_audit until terminal.
Read one AEO audit with normalized terminal status.
List this project's tracked AI-visibility prompt sets.
Read one AI-visibility set, members, rounds, scores, and terminal status.
Start a scoring round and poll magister_get_ai_visibility_set until terminal.
Research keyword ideas plus current domain rankings through DataForSEO.
Start durable creator discovery, then poll magister_get_influencer_discovery until terminal.
Poll one durable creator discovery and return partial or terminal results.
List connected social and advertising accounts for this project.
List project social posts, optionally filtered by status.
Read post, follower, daily, and best-time social analytics.
List this project's advertising campaigns without changing spend.
Read performance analytics for one project-owned advertisement.
Poll a payload-bound approval operation until it is terminal.
Request exact approval to generate a new Gemini image and persist it in project Assets. Existing-image edits are not supported by this action.
Request exact approval to generate one ElevenLabs voice asset.
Request exact approval to generate one to four Ideogram image assets.
Request exact approval to submit one prompt-only job to an allowlisted fal image or video model, then poll magister_get_fal_generation.
Poll one project-bound fal job and persist completed media in project Assets.
Request exact approval to run one bounded user-directed browser task. The action accepts no arbitrary provider options and is never blind-retried.

Run one server-allowlisted, read-only JSON operation against an enabled connected integration. Use only a relative path and documented routing headers; credentials and upstream hosts are Gateway-owned.

input_schema.description:
Model-visible bounded JSON integration request.

Project identity, upstream host, credentials, approval state, and risk are
intentionally absent. The Gateway derives all of them from trusted state.

actions.description: Request exact approval for one reversible external integration change. The Gateway rejects reads, paid-spend changes, and deletes sent here.
Request exact approval for one paid-spend integration mutation. The Gateway independently classifies and applies provider spend guardrails.
Request exact approval for one destructive integration delete. The Gateway independently verifies that the canonical operation is a delete.
Request one-time approval to send this exact payload from the user's connected Gmail.
Request one-time approval to send this exact payload from the project's Magister agent email.

Create an unpublished social draft from the exact supplied media. media_urls accepts saved generated image/video paths or stable public assets; never substitute or regenerate media. Scheduling and publishing are separate approvals.
Request approval to schedule an existing draft at the exact supplied time.
Request approval to publish one exact project-owned social post now.
Create a project-owned advertising campaign in a forced paused state.
Request approval to activate one exact campaign and begin spending.
Pause a project-owned campaign to stop spend; this protective action needs no approval.
Create an unpublished CMS blog draft.
Update an existing CMS draft while forcing it to remain unpublished.
Create a branch and pull request without merging the default branch.
Create a Shopify product in draft state.
Request approval to publish one exact CMS or Shopify draft.
Request approval to merge one exact GitHub pull request.
Submit final persisted evidence for the active plan-task workflow. Call exactly once after every step and asynchronous operation is terminal.

sha256.description: Omit this — it is computed and attested automatically from the file bytes. Never hand-compute or guess a hash.

actions.description: Atomically promote one sandbox-staged artifact into the shared project workspace after hash, path, quota, replacement, and mutation-fence checks.

staged_path.description: Path relative to the attempt directory; it must be under promote/ (the sandbox exposes this directory as MAGISTER_PROMOTION_DIR).
